comparison.objective: Release a hard drive from spring-loaded carrier rails and place it on an anti-static mat; the candidate locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a sprung rail out while lifting and sliding a drive off retaining pins, not concentric torque control.
comparison.success_condition: Drive must clear the carrier and rest on the mat without broken rails, drops, or shocks.
comparison.reason: Both use bimanual reaction management, but spring-tab release plus extraction is distinct from threaded adjustment retention.
